title: Dynamics Near Generic Spacetime Singularities
exact_target: Determine how well BKL dynamics describes generic Einstein solutions approaching spacetime singularities.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006043 (OWR-14298591-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/36, pp. 2033--2112. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: This is a programme covering the extent and limitations of a heuristic, not a claim that every singularity obeys one prescribed BKL sequence.
